podcast.body: Released in 2009, this album's title is not a tribute but rather an artistic reflection on the profound changes Matthew Good observed in Vancouver over 16 years of living downtown. He noted the dramatic diminishment of the city's arts community, particularly its grassroots live venues and overall musical "edge." "the reason that I did it was that I lived downtown for a better part of 16 years. And I saw one of what I think... one of the most dramatic changes that I've ever seen a city undergo."
